title: AI副业在闲鱼上火了
content: Nearly 20 million people work on platforms like Xianyu. In the first half of 2026, Xianyu's AI service orders reached 9.816 million, up 157% year-on-year. AI skills (45.1% of orders), tutorials, and templates are top categories, with AI programming and comic video production growing fastest. Sellers are predominantly young women aged 18-35 from second- and fourth-tier cities. The trend is shifting toward "AIOPC" (AI one-person companies), supported by new government policies. Success requires combining AI with existing skills, starting small, and focusing on solving real customer needs rather than chasing trends or high prices immediately.

title: 刚刚，马斯克终极大招Grok Bot来了
content: SpaceXAI launched Grok Bot, a cloud-based AI agent that operates 24/7 on virtual machines with browsers, file systems, and terminals. It can log into user accounts, process emails, update CRMs, and execute tasks independently, pausing only for human decisions like payments or SSO. Multiple bots can run in parallel and collaborate. The product learns by observing user workflows once, then automates them. Priced at $200-300 monthly, it integrates with Cursor's ecosystem following Musk's $60 billion acquisition, positioning it as a competitor to Anthropic's Claude Cowork.

title: Anthropic 将为 Claude 生成文本加入隐形水印，防范 AI 内容冒充原创
content: Anthropic will embed invisible watermarks in text generated by Claude models to combat AI content being passed off as human work. The watermarks preserve meaning and readability, survive copying and minor editing, and rollout began August 2 for new models with older versions following. This fulfills EU AI Act transparency commitments. Third-party detection tools are planned. The technology has limitations: heavy editing, rewriting, translation, or mixed content may remove watermarks, and detection cannot prove Claude as original source. Anthropic follows Google DeepMind in implementing text watermarking.

title: 一个把 MCP 编码 Agent 往返轮次减少 75%+ 的思路
content: Tura's maintainer describes reducing LLM round-trips in coding agents by 75-80%. Instead of separate model invocations for search, patch, build, test, and lint steps, Tura uses a `command_run` macro tool where the model submits one execution plan with dependencies. The same engineering checks still occur; only dialogue overhead is eliminated. An ecommerce-ad-package benchmark demonstrated five LLM turns reduced to one.
